title: fix(objectql): a predicate update or delete recomputes the parent roll-up summaries its matched rows name (#26950)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XU1LK3XtFTgExsmvSjfSEw7)_

Fixes #26950

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：按条件批量更新/删除(`multi: true` + filter,流程的 `update_record` / `delete_record` 批量节点走的就是它)现在会重算父记录上的汇总字段(count/sum/min/max/avg):删除重算被删子记录原来挂的父记录,更新同时重算旧父和新父。
- **为什么改**：此前批量写只返回影响行数,`recomputeSummaries` 拿不到任何父 id,父记录汇总一直停在旧值,直到某次按 id 写子记录才被纠正。流程批量删除或改挂订单行,订单合计静默错误。
- **风险与回滚**：没有汇总字段指向的对象完全不变,仍是一次批量驱动调用、不多读一行。有汇总时在写之前多读一次匹配行的外键列(已有读取时复用,不重复读)。重算失败与按 id 写一样抛 `SummaryRecomputeError`(记录已写入)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 的 `update()` 谓词分支(`[#26950]` 段,`updateMany` 之前)与 `delete()` 谓词分支(`plan === 'none'` 与走查分支);`packages/objectql/src/summary-aggregate.ts` 的 `withoutDeletedSelfParents`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/builtin/predicate-write-summary-recompute.integration.test.ts`,预期 6 条全绿(真 SQLite 驱动,含两条流程节点用例)。
- **需要你做的**：无,席位落地。

## What changes

The predicate arms of `ObjectQL.update()` and `ObjectQL.delete()` (`multi: true`, no scalar `where.id`) now hand the existing `recomputeSummaries` the matched rows' foreign keys. Seat ruling: no second recompute routine, no new option on `engine.update` / `engine.delete`, no refusal of `multi: true`.

- **Which parents.** A delete hands the matched rows as `previous` (the old parents). An update hands them as `previous` and, merged with the payload the driver receives, as `records` (the new parents), so a reparent recomputes both, as the by-id update does with `priorRecord`.
- **Cheap when there is nothing to recompute.** A new private `summaryForeignKeyColumns(object)` names the FK columns of the roll-up descriptors over the object (`getSummaryDescriptors`). Empty means nothing is read and the arm keeps its single `driver.updateMany` / `driver.deleteMany`.
- **One read, before the write, through the write's own composed AST and driver options.** Only the FK columns are read (`fields: [fk…]`). Where the write already reads its matched rows, that read serves and no second one is made: on an update, the matched-row memo (`readPriorRows`) when a consumer above made it (per-row hooks, per-row validation, the post-hook image check); on a delete, the referential walk's own id read (#26930), which now reads `['id', …fk]`, or, with no walk, the per-row hook read.
- **Failures and atomicity are the by-id path's.** The recompute runs where the by-id arm runs it (after the `after*` dispatch, with the write's context and its transaction handle when there is one), and a failure surfaces as the same `SummaryRecomputeError`. No new error code.
- **A self roll-up's deleted parent is not asked about.** A roll-up over its own object can name, from one matched row, a parent that the same predicate delete removes. Measured during this work: handing that row unfiltered made the delete throw `SummaryRecomputeError` (the parent update answers not-found) after the rows were deleted. `withoutDeletedSelfParents` (in `summary-aggregate.ts`) clears, on the walk arm's rows, only the self-referencing descriptors' FK values that name a row this delete removed. The by-id delete never meets this case (its children's own deletes recompute the parent while it still exists).

## Tests

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/predicate-write-summary-recompute.integration.test.ts` (new; real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + `SqlDriver` better-sqlite3 + `AutomationServicePlugin`, the stack the #26871 flow test boots). An order with a `count` and a `sum` roll-up over `master_detail` lines, two orders per case, roll-ups read out of the driver. Six cases: a predicate delete of both of one order's lines brings it to 0/0 and leaves the other order alone; a predicate update moving both lines to the other order recomputes both (old 0/0, new 3/47); a predicate update of the summed field recomputes the parent it stays under; a predicate delete of a second child that a `set_null` lookup points at (so it takes the referential walk's arm) recomputes the parent and still clears the lookup; a flow `delete_record` with `multi: true`; a flow `update_record` with `multi: true` that reparents.
- `packages/objectql/src/summary-rollup.test.ts`, new section `[#26950]` (6 cases, this file's own fake driver, which learned `updateMany` / `deleteMany`, an ordered read/write log and copying `find` answers). The control: an object no roll-up aggregates makes exactly one `updateMany` and one `deleteMany` and no row read. With a roll-up: a predicate update and a predicate delete each read the matched rows ONCE before the write, `fields: ['inv']`, under the caller's `where`, and land the right totals; with per-row `afterUpdate` / `afterDelete` hooks registered the hooks' read is the only one; with a lookup pointing at the child the walk's id read is the only one and carries `['id', 'inv']`; a self roll-up predicate delete that removes a parent and its child answers its count and recomputes only the surviving root.

## Acceptance notes

- **A predicate write can now end in `SummaryRecomputeError`.** It is the by-id write's existing answer when a parent recompute fails after retries (the rows were written, the roll-up may be stale). Before, a predicate write never asked, so it never failed this way; it left the roll-up stale instead. No write is refused, and no accepted value or shape changes: `Clause-②: no`.
- **Cost.** An object with a roll-up over it pays one FK-only read per predicate write (none when the write already reads its matched rows) and one aggregate plus one parent update per distinct parent per roll-up, as N by-id writes would, deduplicated per parent. No ceiling is added (none was asked). An object no roll-up aggregates pays nothing new.
- **The self roll-up filter runs on the walk arm only.** A roll-up over its own object reaches its parent through a reference to that object, which makes `planCascadeAtomicity` answer other than `'none'`, so its predicate delete always takes the walk arm where the filter sits.
- **No body the #25522 split series moved is edited.** `update()`, `delete()`, `recomputeSummaries` and `getSummaryDescriptors` all still live in `engine.ts`. At start and before opening this PR, no open PR touched `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (#26831 touches `engine-execution-plumbing.ts` only).

## Verification

All local readings below are on head `e3a38f12` (the merge of `main` at `49b50591` into the branch) unless a line names another, worktree `objectstack-issue-26950`, shared container.

<details><summary>Red first, on base 40264bee (before the fix)</summary>

- The flow and engine file, objectql dist built from the base: `Tests 6 failed (6)`. Each parent kept its pre-write roll-up, e.g. `expected { count: 2, total: 42 } to deeply equal { count: +0, total: +0 }` for the predicate delete, and `the old parent: expected { count: 2, total: 42 } …` for the reparent.
- `src/summary-rollup.test.ts` with `engine.ts` restored to the base blob `fb30f0f7` (tree only): `Tests 4 failed | 18 passed (22)`. The four read-discipline cases red; the no-roll-up control stays green, as it must. Restored: blob `31029717` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, objectql rebuilt.
</details>

<details><summary>Green, and the ablations</summary>

- objectql full suite `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` on `f6f89395`: Test Files 475 passed (475), Tests 8883 passed (8883). service-automation full suite on `f6f89395`: Test Files 215 passed (215), Tests 2752 passed (2752).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck`: exit 0 (on `f6f89395`; objectql re-run exit 0 after the last source commit, a type-only change of two casts).
- On `e3a38f12`, after a full build: `summary-rollup`, `engine-cascade-delete-atomic`, `engine-nested-relation-lowering` 55 passed (3 files); the new flow file plus #26871's `delete-record-predicate-referential-walk` 8 passed (2 files).
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/objectql packages/services/service-automation`: exit 0, no output.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob moved, restored to HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty), objectql rebuilt and `ablation-dist-preflight` finding the marker in dist where the flow file was read:
  1. The update hands no new FKs (`next: previous`): flow file 2 failed (both reparent cases), objectql 2 failed.
  2. The walk arm keeps no FK rows: flow file 1 failed (the walk case), objectql 1 failed.
  3. No reuse of the per-row hook read: objectql 1 failed (the reuse case); the flow file stays green, as it should, since an extra read changes no total.
  4. The self roll-up filter removed: objectql 1 failed, the delete throwing `SummaryRecomputeError`.
  The restore leg rebuilt objectql and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` was clean for every marker.
</details>
